records.context: The strip sits directly above the processing session button of a workflow screen and shows three things:
records.label: spacr.qt.chaining#1
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: The strip sits directly above the Run button of a pipeline screen and shows three things:
records.translation: 이 띠는 파이프라인 화면의 Run 버튼 바로 위에 있으며 세 가지를 보여 줍니다:

records.context: **what it will read.**  :mod:`spacr.chaining` asks the artifact registry where the previous module actually wrote and fills this module's source folder with it, so Measure opened after Mask has the laboratory microplate folder filled in.  A path the user typed themselves is *pinned* and never overwritten — when the upstream later moves, the new location is offered beside the pinned one with a button, never pushed into the microscope field of view;
records.label: spacr.qt.chaining#2
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **what it will read.**  :mod:`spacr.chaining` asks the artifact registry where the previous module actually wrote and fills this module's source folder with it, so Measure opened after Mask has the plate folder filled in.  A path the user typed themselves is *pinned* and never overwritten — when the upstream later moves, the new location is offered beside the pinned one with a button, never pushed into the field;
records.translation: **무엇을 읽을지.** :mod:`spacr.chaining`은 산출물 레지스트리에 이전 모듈이 실제로 어디에 기록했는지 묻고 그 위치로 이 모듈의 소스 폴더를 채우므로, Mask 다음에 연 Measure에는 플레이트 폴더가 채워져 있습니다. 사용자가 직접 입력한 경로는 *고정*되어 절대 덮어쓰이지 않습니다 — 나중에 상위 단계의 위치가 바뀌면 새 위치가 버튼과 함께 고정된 경로 옆에 제안될 뿐, 필드에 강제로 들어가지 않습니다;

records.context: **what is out of date.**  :func:`spacr.chaining.staleness_notes` turns the registry's cause codes into a sentence and a fix, so "these measurements came from a Mask run you have since redone" is on application view *before* the figure is opened rather than discovered afterwards;
records.label: spacr.qt.chaining#3
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **what is out of date.**  :func:`spacr.chaining.staleness_notes` turns the registry's cause codes into a sentence and a fix, so "these measurements came from a Mask run you have since redone" is on screen *before* the figure is opened rather than discovered afterwards;
records.translation: **무엇이 오래되었는지.** :func:`spacr.chaining.staleness_notes`는 레지스트리의 원인 코드를 문장과 해결 방법으로 바꾸므로, "these measurements came from a Mask run you have since redone"(이 측정값은 이후 다시 실행한 Mask 실행에서 나왔음)이 그림을 연 뒤에 발견되는 것이 아니라 열기 *전에* 화면에 표시됩니다;

records.context: **what comes next.**  A finished processing session offers its successors from :func:`spacr.ports.next_modules`, each pre-filled with the artifact just produced and each checked with :func:`spacr.ports.check_ready` — so an offer either works, or is shown greyed with the reason it cannot.
records.label: spacr.qt.chaining#4
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **what comes next.**  A finished run offers its successors from :func:`spacr.ports.next_modules`, each pre-filled with the artifact just produced and each checked with :func:`spacr.ports.check_ready` — so an offer either works, or is shown greyed with the reason it cannot.
records.translation: **다음에 할 일.** 완료된 실행은 :func:`spacr.ports.next_modules`에서 후속 모듈을 제안하며, 각 제안은 방금 만들어진 산출물로 미리 채워지고 :func:`spacr.ports.check_ready`로 확인됩니다 — 따라서 제안은 동작하거나, 아니면 동작할 수 없는 이유와 함께 회색으로 표시됩니다.

records.context: Installation goes through the two seams that already exist rather than through the shared application view: :data:`spacr.qt.app.APP_FACTORIES` (consulted by ``MainWindow._build_screen`` before its built-in chain) and :data:`spacr.qt.SELF_REGISTERING_MODULES`, which imports this module after ``app.py`` is loaded and before the first window is built.  ``AppScreen`` itself is untouched.
records.label: spacr.qt.chaining#5
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Installation goes through the two seams that already exist rather than through the shared screen: :data:`spacr.qt.app.APP_FACTORIES` (consulted by ``MainWindow._build_screen`` before its built-in chain) and :data:`spacr.qt.SELF_REGISTERING_MODULES`, which imports this module after ``app.py`` is loaded and before the first window is built.  ``AppScreen`` itself is untouched.
records.translation: 설치는 공유 화면을 거치지 않고 이미 존재하는 두 연결 지점을 거칩니다: :data:`spacr.qt.app.APP_FACTORIES`(``MainWindow._build_screen``이 내장 체인보다 먼저 참조함)와 :data:`spacr.qt.SELF_REGISTERING_MODULES`이며, 후자는 ``app.py``가 로드된 뒤 첫 창이 만들어지기 전에 이 모듈을 import합니다. ``AppScreen`` 자체는 건드리지 않습니다.

records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: :func:`register` is the whole of the installation and is idempotent, so a build whose launch list has not yet learned about this module can call it from anywhere that runs before the first window.
records.translation: :func:`register`가 설치의 전부이며 멱등적이므로, 실행 목록이 아직 이 모듈을 모르는 빌드에서도 첫 창 이전에 실행되는 곳이라면 어디서든 호출할 수 있습니다.

records.context: The ROI feature is split across two modules. :mod:`spacr.roi` is the half that executes in a measurement worker — the geometry, the keep/drop rule and the environment route that gets both into a ``spawn`` pool. This is the half that needs a mouse: a pen that turns clicks into a :class:`spacr.layers.Shape`, and a panel that turns the shapes layer into a :class:`spacr.roi.RoiSet` and switches the measurement filter on.
records.label: spacr.qt.roi_tool#1
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: The ROI feature is split across two modules. :mod:`spacr.roi` is the half that runs in a measurement worker — the geometry, the keep/drop rule and the environment route that gets both into a ``spawn`` pool. This is the half that needs a mouse: a pen that turns clicks into a :class:`spacr.layers.Shape`, and a panel that turns the shapes layer into a :class:`spacr.roi.RoiSet` and switches the measurement filter on.
records.translation: ROI 기능은 두 모듈에 나뉘어 있습니다. :mod:`spacr.roi`는 측정 작업자에서 실행되는 절반입니다 — 기하 구조, 유지/제외 규칙, 그리고 둘을 ``spawn`` 풀에 전달하는 환경 경로입니다. 이 모듈은 마우스가 필요한 절반입니다: 클릭을 :class:`spacr.layers.Shape`로 바꾸는 펜과, 도형 레이어를 :class:`spacr.roi.RoiSet`으로 바꾸고 측정 필터를 켜는 패널입니다.

records.context: Every vertex is a world coordinate taken from :meth:`spacr.layers.Canvas.world_at`, and the polygon being drawn is a real :class:`~spacr.layers.Shape` in a real :class:`~spacr.layers.ShapesLayer`. So the half-finished ROI is rendered by the same compositor as everything else, it survives a zoom, and the finished ROI is already in the form :meth:`spacr.roi.RoiSet.from_shapes_layer` reads. Nothing about the drawing is in pixels, which is what lets an ROI drawn on a downsampled preview name the same region on a full-resolution mask.
records.label: spacr.qt.roi_tool#3
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Every vertex is a world coordinate taken from :meth:`spacr.layers.Canvas.world_at`, and the polygon being drawn is a real :class:`~spacr.layers.Shape` in a real :class:`~spacr.layers.ShapesLayer`. So the half-finished ROI is rendered by the same compositor as everything else, it survives a zoom, and the finished ROI is already in the form :meth:`spacr.roi.RoiSet.from_shapes_layer` reads. Nothing about the drawing is in pixels, which is what lets an ROI drawn on a downsampled preview name the same region on a full-resolution mask.
records.translation: 모든 꼭짓점은 :meth:`spacr.layers.Canvas.world_at`에서 얻은 월드 좌표이며, 그리는 중인 다각형은 실제 :class:`~spacr.layers.Shape`이며 실제 :class:`~spacr.layers.ShapesLayer` 안에 있습니다. 따라서 그리다 만 ROI도 다른 모든 것과 같은 합성기로 렌더링되고, 확대해도 유지되며, 완성된 ROI는 이미 :meth:`spacr.roi.RoiSet.from_shapes_layer`가 읽는 형태입니다. 그리기의 어떤 부분도 픽셀 단위가 아니므로, 축소된 미리 보기에 그린 ROI가 전체 해상도 마스크에서도 같은 영역을 가리킬 수 있습니다.

records.context: The disclosure level is changed only when necessary, and the change is not remembered. Switching to All settings unconditionally would work, and it would also rewrite this module's remembered Essentials/All choice every time anybody arrived here -- a setting the user chose, changed as a side effect of looking something up. So the filter is cleared first and the level is raised only when the row is still not on the form afterwards, which is exactly the case where Essentials is what is hiding it; and the raise goes through :meth:`_show_all_without_remembering`, so the form shows the row while the store still holds the level the user picked. Most settings are not essentials, so a lookup that persisted the raise would move almost every module out of Essentials for good.

records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: The disclosure level is changed only when necessary, and the change is not remembered. Switching to All settings unconditionally would work, and it would also rewrite this module's remembered Essentials/All choice every time anybody arrived here -- a setting the user chose, changed as a side effect of looking something up. So the filter is cleared first and the level is raised only when the row is still not on the form afterwards, which is exactly the case where Essentials is what is hiding it; and the raise goes through :meth:`_show_all_without_remembering`, so the form shows the row while the store still holds the level the user picked. Most settings are not essentials, so a lookup that persisted the raise would move almost every module out of Essentials for good.
records.translation: 공개 수준은 필요할 때만 바뀌며, 그 변경은 기억되지 않습니다. 무조건 All 설정으로 전환해도 동작은 하겠지만, 누군가 여기에 올 때마다 이 모듈에 기억된 Essentials/All 선택을 다시 쓰게 됩니다 -- 사용자가 선택한 설정이 무언가를 찾아보는 일의 부작용으로 바뀌는 것입니다. 그래서 먼저 필터를 지우고, 그 뒤에도 행이 양식에 없을 때만 수준을 올립니다. 이는 정확히 Essentials가 그 행을 숨기고 있는 경우입니다. 그리고 수준 올리기는 :meth:`_show_all_without_remembering`을 거치므로, 양식은 그 행을 보여 주면서도 저장소에는 사용자가 고른 수준이 그대로 남습니다. 대부분의 설정은 필수 항목이 아니므로, 수준 올리기를 저장하는 조회는 거의 모든 모듈을 영영 Essentials에서 벗어나게 만들 것입니다.

records.context: :func:`spacr.qt.bridge.registry` -- the process-wide ``RunRegistry`` that ``make_thread`` adds every job to. Not an ad-hoc "busy" flag each caller has to remember to set and, more importantly, remember to clear: the registry is the same state every application view's ``active_jobs()`` is counting, and it is maintained by ``make_thread`` itself, so a job that forgets to tell anyone it started still turns the spinner on.

records.context: So the widget waits :func:`spacr.qt.preferences.get_spinner_delay` seconds (default 2) before showing. The mechanism is a **delay, not a prediction**: :meth:`ActivitySpinner._sync` starts a single-shot timer the moment work begins and the spinner becomes visible only if :meth:`ActivitySpinner.is_busy` is *still* true when that timer fires. A job that finishes at 1.9 s cancels the timer on its way out and never puts anything on application view -- no duration is estimated.

records.source: ``spacr/resources/icons/loading_spinner.gif`` is the asset this widget was asked to reuse, and it is not reused, for three measured reasons:
records.translation: ``spacr/resources/icons/loading_spinner.gif``는 이 위젯이 재사용하도록 요청받은 에셋이지만, 측정된 세 가지 이유로 재사용하지 않습니다:

records.context: **Size.** 800x600, 144 frames, 682 KB on disk. ``QMovie`` decodes a frame to a 32-bit ``QImage``, so one frame is 800 x 600 x 4 = 1.92 MB and the whole loop is 276 MB. ``QMovie.CacheAll`` holds all of it; ``CacheNone`` (the default) trades that for re-decoding 1.92 MB, and rescaling it to 16 px, 33 times a second, forever.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.activity_spinner#3
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **Size.** 800x600, 144 frames, 682 KB on disk. ``QMovie`` decodes a frame to a 32-bit ``QImage``, so one frame is 800 x 600 x 4 = 1.92 MB and the whole loop is 276 MB. ``QMovie.CacheAll`` holds all of it; ``CacheNone`` (the default) trades that for re-decoding 1.92 MB, and rescaling it to 16 px, 33 times a second, forever.
records.translation: **크기.** 800x600, 144프레임, 디스크에서 682 KB입니다. ``QMovie``는 프레임을 32비트 ``QImage``로 디코딩하므로, 프레임 하나가 800 x 600 x 4 = 1.92 MB이고 전체 루프는 276 MB입니다. ``QMovie.CacheAll``은 이를 모두 보유하고, ``CacheNone``(기본값)은 그 대신 1.92 MB를 다시 디코딩하여 16 px로 축소하는 일을 초당 33번, 끝없이 반복합니다.

records.context: **Transparency.** Every pixel of every frame has alpha 255 and the background is ``#000000``. The GIF is not a sprite, it is a *video of* a spinner. Dropped beside "Clear console" it paints an opaque black square, which is invisible in the dark theme and a hole in the light one.

records.translation: **투명도.** 모든 프레임의 모든 픽셀이 알파 255이고 배경은 ``#000000``입니다. 이 GIF는 스프라이트가 아니라 스피너의 *동영상*입니다. "Clear console" 옆에 두면 불투명한 검은 사각형이 그려지며, 이는 어두운 테마에서는 보이지 않고 밝은 테마에서는 구멍처럼 보입니다.

records.context: Pre-scaling the frames once into ``QPixmap`` objects fixes the per-frame cost but none of the other two, and it still costs a 276 MB decode pass at start-up for a 16 px dot. So the motif is redrawn instead: the GIF's *character* is a thin ring with a double-helix braid travelling around it (see the frames -- the braid sweeps, the ring stays), and that is exactly what :meth:`ActivitySpinner.paintEvent` draws with two ``QPolygonF`` objects. It costs microseconds, it takes its colours from the live palette so it themes in both light and dark, and it is sharp at any size.

records.source: Pre-scaling the frames once into ``QPixmap`` objects fixes the per-frame cost but none of the other two, and it still costs a 276 MB decode pass at start-up for a 16 px dot. records.context: A collision is shown, not resolved. Two databases that each hold a ``plate1`` are two experiments, and the widget says so and names them. The resolutions offered are the ones that keep the experiment analysable -- remove one of the databases, or rename the laboratory microplates.

Returning ``['/data/plate1']`` where a string was returned before would change what every one of those sees for a user who chose one folder -- exactly the regression the one-element list caused for ``column_csv`` (see ``settings_model.PATH_LIST_SINGLE_KEYS``).
records.translation: 항상 목록인 것은 아닙니다. ``src``는 spaCR에 모듈이 생긴 이래 모든 모듈에서 문자열이었으며, 설정 CSV에 기록되고, CLI가 읽고, 실행 일지가 재생하며, ``os.path.join(src, ...)``을 하는 모든 것이 이어 붙입니다. 예전에 문자열을 반환하던 곳에서 ``['/data/plate1']``을 반환하면 폴더 하나를 선택한 사용자에 대해 그 모든 곳이 보는 값이 바뀝니다 -- 원소 하나짜리 목록이 ``column_csv``에서 일으킨 바로 그 회귀입니다(``settings_model.PATH_LIST_SINGLE_KEYS`` 참조).

records.translation: 서랍은 *드러내기* 방식입니다: 왼쪽 가장자리를 따라 있는 6 px 띠에 포인터가 머물면 패널 전체가 페이지 위로 미끄러져 나오고, 포인터가 떠나면 다시 미끄러져 들어갑니다. 주 창은 서랍을 닫힌 비활성 상태로 두고 앱 목록을 독 열로 보여 주거나 숨깁니다(:meth:`spacr.qt.app.MainWindow.apply_dock_mode` 참조).

records.context: Three things make the difference between a reveal that feels deliberate and one that fires while you are aiming at something else:
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.drawer#2
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Three things make the difference between a reveal that feels deliberate and one that fires while you are aiming at something else:
records.translation: 의도적으로 느껴지는 드러내기와 다른 것을 겨냥하는 도중에 실행되는 드러내기의 차이를 만드는 것은 세 가지입니다:

records.context: **Dwell, not touch.** Entering the strip starts :data:`EdgeDrawer.OPEN_DELAY_MS`; a pointer that crosses the strip on its way somewhere else has left again before the timer fires.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.drawer#3
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **Dwell, not touch.** Entering the strip starts :data:`EdgeDrawer.OPEN_DELAY_MS`; a pointer that crosses the strip on its way somewhere else has left again before the timer fires.
records.translation: **접촉이 아니라 머무름.** 띠에 들어가면 :data:`EdgeDrawer.OPEN_DELAY_MS`가 시작됩니다. 다른 곳으로 가는 길에 띠를 지나간 포인터는 타이머가 실행되기 전에 이미 떠난 상태입니다.

records.context: **A generous close.** Leaving does *not* close immediately — :data:`EdgeDrawer.CLOSE_DELAY_MS` covers the gap between the panel and wherever the pointer wobbled to, and any re-entry cancels it. Panels that snap shut the instant the pointer strays are unusable with a trackpad.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.drawer#4
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **A generous close.** Leaving does *not* close immediately — :data:`EdgeDrawer.CLOSE_DELAY_MS` covers the gap between the panel and wherever the pointer wobbled to, and any re-entry cancels it. Panels that snap shut the instant the pointer strays are unusable with a trackpad.
records.translation: **넉넉한 닫기.** 떠나도 즉시 닫히지 *않습니다* — :data:`EdgeDrawer.CLOSE_DELAY_MS`가 패널과 포인터가 흔들려 간 위치 사이의 틈을 메우며, 다시 들어오면 닫기가 취소됩니다. 포인터가 벗어나는 순간 탁 닫히는 패널은 트랙패드로는 쓸 수 없습니다.

records.context: **A pin.** Clicking any row while the drawer is open would otherwise race the close animation. :meth:`hold` keeps it open until something explicitly releases it, which is also how the keyboard path works.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.drawer#5
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **A pin.** Clicking any row while the drawer is open would otherwise race the close animation. :meth:`hold` keeps it open until something explicitly releases it, which is also how the keyboard path works.
records.translation: **고정.** 서랍이 열려 있는 동안 행을 클릭하면 그렇지 않을 경우 닫기 애니메이션과 경쟁하게 됩니다. :meth:`hold`는 무언가가 명시적으로 풀어 줄 때까지 서랍을 열어 두며, 키보드 경로도 이 방식으로 동작합니다.

records.context: **It is not mouse-only.** :meth:`open_for_keyboard` opens the drawer, pins it, and focuses the first row; Escape (or focus leaving the panel) closes it again. The window installs a shortcut for this — a reveal you can only reach by hovering is a reveal a keyboard user cannot reach at all.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.drawer#6
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **It is not mouse-only.** :meth:`open_for_keyboard` opens the drawer, pins it, and focuses the first row; Escape (or focus leaving the panel) closes it again. records.context: The event type is read first, and the liveness checks follow it. This filter is on the QApplication, so both `_still_alive` calls used to execute for every event in the process -- 94,431 of them during one Regression open, and a profile counted the pair at 839,906 calls in one Mask open. Reading the type of an object whose C++ half has gone raises, which the `except` below already answers with the same `False`, so the order costs nothing and the checks now run only for a context menu.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.feature_dictionary.FeatureHelpFilter.eventFilter#1
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: The event type is read first, and the liveness checks follow it. This filter is on the QApplication, so both `_still_alive` calls used to run for every event in the process -- 94,431 of them during one Regression open, and a profile counted the pair at 839,906 calls in one Mask open. Reading the type of an object whose C++ half has gone raises, which the `except` below already answers with the same `False`, so the order costs nothing and the checks now run only for a context menu.
records.translation: 이벤트 유형을 먼저 읽고, 생존 확인은 그 뒤에 합니다. 이 필터는 QApplication에 있으므로 예전에는 두 번의 `_still_alive` 호출이 프로세스의 모든 이벤트에 대해 실행되었습니다 -- Regression을 한 번 열 때 94,431개였고, 프로필에서는 Mask를 한 번 열 때 그 쌍이 839,906번 호출된 것으로 집계되었습니다. C++ 쪽이 사라진 객체의 유형을 읽으면 예외가 발생하는데, 아래의 `except` 블록이 이미 같은 `False` 값으로 답하므로 이 순서에는 비용이 없고, 이제 확인은 컨텍스트 메뉴에 대해서만 실행됩니다.

records.context: Only one tooltip ever appears. The application views that anchor this popup also leave a native Qt tooltip on the same label (``refresh_api_tooltips`` re-applies it on every ``Enter``, for the accessibility tree), and Qt's own tooltip timer would pop that up a second later, on top of this one — two tooltips, one after the other. Claiming an anchor therefore installs :class:`_NativeTooltipSuppressor` on it, which swallows ``QEvent.ToolTip`` while leaving ``toolTip()`` intact for application view readers.

records.source: The same rule Mask and the Mask live preview follow: the run declares `number_of_organelles`, and every panel shows that many. Without it the crop settings offered a fixed four -- so a one-organelle run had three mask-slice and three minimum-area fields for objects it does not have, and each of them propagates into the settings the run reads.
records.translation: Mask와 Mask 실시간 미리 보기가 따르는 것과 같은 규칙입니다: 실행이 `number_of_organelles` 값을 선언하면 모든 패널이 그만큼 표시합니다. 이것이 없으면 크롭 설정은 고정된 네 개를 제공했습니다 -- 그래서 소기관이 하나인 실행에는 존재하지 않는 객체를 위한 마스크 슬라이스 필드와 최소 면적 필드가 세 개씩 있었고, 각각이 실행이 읽는 설정으로 전파되었습니다.

records.context: It builds them as well as showing them. This used to change only what was SHOWN, over 702 slots' worth of controls that `_build_controls` had already made -- so the answer to "a run with no organelle" was 2,117 controls hidden behind a data-selection boundary. The count is now what brings a slot's controls into existence, which is why raising it is the only route that has to work.

records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: IT BUILDS THEM AS WELL AS SHOWING THEM. The count is now what brings a slot's controls into existence, which is why raising it is the only route that has to work.
records.translation: 표시할 뿐 아니라 만들기도 합니다. 예전에는 `_build_controls` 메서드가 이미 만들어 둔 702개 슬롯 분량의 컨트롤 중 무엇을 보여 줄지만 바꿨습니다 -- 그래서 "a run with no organelle"(소기관 없는 실행)에 대한 답은 표시 여부 뒤에 숨겨진 2,117개의 컨트롤이었습니다. 이제는 개수가 슬롯의 컨트롤을 존재하게 만들며, 그래서 개수를 늘리는 것이 반드시 동작해야 하는 유일한 경로입니다.

records.context: Colour: every colour painted here is derived from the theme that is on application view, never written as a literal, and the derivation preserves the relative luminance of the theme's own accent role. That is what lets an arbitrary number of barcode types each get a colour of their own without any of them becoming unreadable on any theme.

records.context: The ray from the centre, not the nearest edge. Projecting a point onto whichever edge happens to be closest is discontinuous along the diagonals: the pointer crosses one and the target jumps from the middle of the top edge to the middle of the left, which is what was reported as the rim being unsynced with the pointer inside the card. The point where the ray from the centre through the pointer leaves the rectangle moves continuously, and is always the place on the rim that is actually in the pointer's direction -- which is what "flows towards the mouse" has to mean if the mouse can be anywhere.

records.translation: ``TrackStats``는 30프레임 시리즈에서 한 시야가 중앙값 길이 6프레임인 트랙 41개를 만들었다고 알려 줄 수 있습니다. 하지만 *왜* 그런지는 알려 줄 수 없으며, 원인에 따라 바꿔야 할 설정이 달라집니다: 세 프레임 동안 맞닿았다가 식별자가 뒤바뀐 채 떨어지는 두 세포에는, 시야를 떠났다가 돌아오는 세포 하나와는 다른 설정이 필요합니다.

records.source: So this shows the frames. One field plays as a movie; clicking it opens a filmstrip above, which is the same frames laid out at once and scrollable, because a break is easiest to find by scrubbing and easiest to *understand* by seeing the frames either side of it together.
records.translation: 그래서 이 모듈은 프레임을 보여 줍니다. 한 시야가 동영상으로 재생되고, 이를 클릭하면 위쪽에 필름 띠가 열립니다. 필름 띠는 같은 프레임을 한꺼번에 펼쳐 스크롤할 수 있게 한 것으로, 끊김은 앞뒤로 훑어볼 때 가장 찾기 쉽고 그 양쪽 프레임을 함께 볼 때 가장 *이해하기* 쉽기 때문입니다.

records.context: Everything reuses the rendering already in :mod:`spacr.qt.widgets.timelapse_preview` -- ``render_frame`` colours mask outlines by track id and draws the trailing polyline, and ``track_colour`` is deterministic, so a colour identifies a track: an object that keeps its track id keeps its colour in every frame and in every thumbnail, so an identity swap reads as an object that changes colour partway through the strip.

records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Everything reuses the rendering already in :mod:`spacr.qt.widgets.timelapse_preview` -- ``render_frame`` colours mask outlines by track id and draws the trailing polyline, and ``track_colour`` is deterministic, so a colour identifies a track: an object that keeps its track id keeps its colour in every frame and in every thumbnail, so an identity swap reads as an object that changes colour partway through the strip.

records.context: Three design rules:
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.volcano_explorer#2
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Three design rules:
records.translation: 세 가지 설계 규칙:

records.context: **One renderer.** Every pixel comes from :func:`spacr.volcano_style.render_volcano`, the same function the headless workflow calls. Exporting re-renders from the same :class:`VolcanoStyle` at print size rather than screenshotting the widget, so what is saved is what was on application view, at full vector quality.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.volcano_explorer#3
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **One renderer.** Every pixel comes from :func:`spacr.volcano_style.render_volcano`, the same function the headless pipeline calls. Exporting re-renders from the same :class:`VolcanoStyle` at print size rather than screenshotting the widget, so what is saved is what was on screen, at full vector quality.
records.translation: **렌더러는 하나.** 모든 픽셀은 헤드리스 파이프라인이 호출하는 것과 같은 함수인 :func:`spacr.volcano_style.render_volcano`에서 나옵니다. 내보내기는 위젯을 화면 캡처하지 않고 같은 :class:`VolcanoStyle`로 인쇄 크기에서 다시 렌더링하므로, 저장되는 것은 화면에 있던 것과 같으며 완전한 벡터 품질입니다.

records.context: **The style is a value.** Controls write into a :class:`~spacr.volcano_style.VolcanoStyle` and ask for a redraw. That makes the whole appearance saveable to JSON, reloadable, and reproducible.
records.label: spacr.qt.widgets.volcano_explorer#4
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **The style is a value.** Controls write into a :class:`~spacr.volcano_style.VolcanoStyle` and ask for a redraw. That makes the whole appearance saveable to JSON, reloadable, and reproducible.
records.translation: **스타일은 값입니다.** 컨트롤은 :class:`~spacr.volcano_style.VolcanoStyle`에 기록하고 다시 그리기를 요청합니다. 이 덕분에 전체 모양을 JSON으로 저장하고, 다시 불러오고, 재현할 수 있습니다.
